text:
How a car engine turns fuel into motion, in 40 seconds.
Four strokes: suck (intake), squeeze (compression), bang (power), blow (exhaust). Cylinders fire in the order 1-3-4-2.

Quiz: In which stroke does the engine actually push the car?
A) Intake  B) Compression  C) Power  D) Exhaust
answer: C) Power. Burning fuel pushes the piston down; the crankshaft turns that push into rotation.

text:
DNA in under a minute.
Two strands twist into a double helix. The bases pair up across the middle.

Quiz: In DNA, adenine (A) pairs with?
A) Guanine  B) Thymine  C) Cytosine  D) Uracil
answer: B) Thymine. A pairs with T, G pairs with C. (In RNA, A pairs with uracil instead.)

text:
How your heart pumps, step by step.
Right side sends blood to the lungs; left side sends it to the whole body.

Quiz: Which chamber pumps blood to the whole body?
A) Right atrium  B) Right ventricle  C) Left atrium  D) Left ventricle
answer: D) Left ventricle. That is why its wall is the thickest.

text:
Projectile motion: why the ball flies in a curve.
Sideways speed stays the same; gravity changes only the up-down speed.

Quiz: On level ground with no air resistance, which launch angle gives the longest range?
A) 30°  B) 45°  C) 60°  D) 90°
answer: B) 45°. Range R = u² sin 2θ / g is largest when sin 2θ = 1, so θ = 45°.

text:
Mitosis: one cell becomes two identical cells.
Prophase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase, then the cell splits.

Quiz: In which phase do chromosomes line up in the middle of the cell?
A) Prophase  B) Metaphase  C) Anaphase  D) Telophase
answer: B) Metaphase. They line up on the metaphase plate before the sister chromatids are pulled apart.

text:
The 2012 paper that made gene editing easy (Jinek, Doudna, Charpentier and colleagues, Science).
A guide RNA leads a protein to the exact DNA spot, which it cuts.

Quiz: Which protein cuts the DNA in CRISPR gene editing?
A) Ligase  B) Helicase  C) Cas9  D) Polymerase
answer: C) Cas9. It won Doudna and Charpentier the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

text:
How a kidney nephron cleans your blood.
Filter, take back what is useful, send the rest out as urine.

Quiz: Where does filtration of blood start in the nephron?
A) Loop of Henle  B) Glomerulus  C) Collecting duct  D) Ureter
answer: B) Glomerulus, a ball of capillaries inside Bowman's capsule.

text:
From gene to protein: transcription and translation.
DNA is copied into mRNA; a ribosome reads mRNA three letters at a time.

Quiz: Where does translation take place?
A) Nucleus  B) Ribosome  C) Mitochondria  D) Golgi body
answer: B) Ribosome. Each three-letter codon on mRNA calls for one amino acid.

text:
The 2017 paper behind ChatGPT: "Attention Is All You Need".
Every word looks at every other word at once, instead of one word at a time.

Quiz: What does the T in GPT stand for?
A) Transfer  B) Transformer  C) Token  D) Tensor
answer: B) Transformer, the model introduced in that 2017 paper.

text:
How a graphics card turns data into pixels (a simplified model).
Thousands of small cores work in groups called warps; data travels from memory through caches.

Quiz: How many threads are in one NVIDIA warp?
A) 8  B) 16  C) 32  D) 64
answer: C) 32 threads that run the same instruction together.
